positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Engage in modern front-end web and application development for greenfield and brownfield projects in an agency-like environment using various technologies tailored to each project.

Extensive experience with web & reactive JavaScript frameworks, responsive design, templating engines, CMS's, virtual environments, module bundlers and design tools.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Contracted with this startup to design and build the front end of custom gaming web apps developed  to engage fans and increase revenue for various sports organizations.  

Implemented clean, fast and responsive user interfaces with a modern stack including CSS/Sass, React.js and Node.js. 

Tested and optimized web apps for cross-browser support.

Proposed product enhancements and the adoption of new features, including new plugins and technologies.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
Worked with Advisor Launchpad (a Smarsh company at the time) and built professional, modern websites for financial institutions from scratch via custom Photoshop mockups.

Utilized HTML5, CSS3/Sass, JavaScript/jQuery, Bootstrap and Node.js build tools.

Assisted with advising clients on optimal UX, layout, organization, form structure, images and color themes.

Debugged, QA’d, troubleshot and improved various front-end development issues daily on multiple platforms supporting 5000+ custom or template websites.

Imported sites into ALP 2.0, our customized Ektron CMS built with an AngularJS front end utilizing robust HTML to ASP.NET build systems. 

Maintained and modified legacy code on older platforms.

Implemented extensive front end testing to ensure cross-browser support.

positions.title: Web Content Specialist
positions.description:
Updated and improved the national and international Wacom E-Commerce stores.

Worked alongside designers to produce engaging web pages for new products and sponsored Wacom artists.

Successfully created, updated and maintained web pages with tight deadlines using Sitecore and Insite CMS's.

Used JIRA and Confluence to optimize team collaboration and issue tracking.

positions.title: Web Content Administrator
positions.description:
Worked with Advisor Launchpad (a Smarsh company at the time) to create, update and maintain the layout, marketing materials, content and forms of websites for financial institutions.

Utilized HTML5, CSS3/Sass, JavaScript/jQuery and Bootstrap in multiple customized CMS environments.

Troubleshot and debugged various cross-browser responsive issues on hundreds of clients websites. 

Eventually hired on full-time after a 9-month contract and promoted to Front-End Web Developer.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: During my internship, I created an email template with a rich-text editor as an added feature to a package of custom services offered by Tiger Sheep, LLC. I also worked alongside the development team researching, wire framing and building a support ticketing system. Tiger Sheep specializes in facilitating user experience and workflow with SAP Business One for clients via innovative modern web applications and software training.

positions.title: Guest Services Coordinator
positions.description: Help facilitate guest experience at the Downtown Waterfront Marriott hotel by providing superior customer service and management.

positions.title: Composer / Music Producer
positions.description:
Almost 10 years experience as an ASCAP member composing, producing and licensing music.

Hundreds of placements worldwide in TV, film, advertising and video games in a variety of genres with expertise in producing, engineering, mixing and mastering.

Has become a side hustle since 2015.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Music Technology: Music, Computer Programming & Sound Design; Minor: Business Administration
